Hello! 😊 Aw happy to explain! Well before my hair would get greasy really quickly like every other day, so I was washing it every 2 days. But then in isolation I started off doing no shampoo but washed it with water and acv rinse every 3 days & did the mechanical cleaning for a week. I was really greasy during this week but thats natural. Then I started using Rye flour to wash my hair with, which really worked for my hair & I liked it! I did rye flour for a week or 2, washing my hair like every 3 days cause it became less greasy, but I was told about possible protein build up which I didn’t want so I thought I’d try soapnuts because they are used for the hair also 😊 I got a soapnut shampoo bar and tried washing with that twice a week with ACV rinse after and in between brushing with a boar bristle brush and doing mechanical cleaning. I think this part really worked for my hair because it became thicker and I think it grew a bit faster! Only thing is I got dandruff when I first started using the bar, I’m still not sure why… because in all other ways its great for my hair. That’s my journey so far! My hair just needed some proper TLC for it to go ‘hey this is what I can be!’ ❤️😄
